# The Practice - Therapy & Wellness Practice

> Warm, evidence-based care for individuals, couples and families — in person and online.

## Services
- Individual Therapy: Anxiety, depression, life transitions, personal growth.
- Couples Therapy: Communication, rebuilding intimacy, conflict resolution.
- Teens & Families: Supporting adolescents and family dynamics.
- Online Therapy: Secure, HIPAA-compliant telehealth sessions.

## Locations & Modalities
- In-person and online appointments available.
- Free 15-minute consultations to match with the right therapist.
